name: janhvi-telegram-bot
description: Janhvi Telegram moderation bot with persistent owner-controlled welcome system

BOT_OWNER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to manage bot-wide settings

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI used for persistent bot configuration

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org/apps for the optional history client

API_HASH.description: Telegram API hash from my.telegram.org/apps for the optional history client

SESSION_STRING.description: Optional authenticated Telegram user session for history lookups; keep secret
